crossRefs.note: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.
The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
“I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who…
Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner. Blue and purple…
“ ‘ “Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with…
“ ‘ “Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares: bright iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.
“Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy…
Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes; even many…
You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you, and many peoples with you, all of them…
“You, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh…
and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them…
